description: This file defines the SwiftUI view 'InstancesSettings' for displaying connected instances, their statuses, and related UI components within the OpenClaw project. It includes UI layout code, helper functions, and testing extensions.

classes.name: InstancesSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays the status and details of connected instances, including error messages, a list of instances, and controls for refresh actions.

classes.name: InstanceInfo
classes.description: Data model representing individual instance details such as host, IP, version, platform, device, mode, and timestamps.

classes.name: DevicePresentation
classes.description: A model used for presenting device-specific information such as title and symbol.

classes.name: AndroidMark
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that renders a stylized Android logo icon.

methods.name: exerciseForTesting
methods.description: Static method creating sample data and testing various UI functions for development purposes.

methods.name: header
methods.description: Constructs the header section of the InstancesSettings view, including the title and refresh button.

methods.name: instanceRow
methods.description: Builds the UI for a single instance row, displaying host, IP, version, device info, and status indicators.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Helper for creating icon + text labels.

methods.name: presenceIndicator
methods.description: Displays a circle and label indicating the presence status (Active, Idle, Stale) of an instance.

methods.name: presenceStatus
methods.description: Determines presence label and color based on age of last activity.

methods.name: leadingDeviceIcon
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon for a device based on device info.

methods.name: leadingDeviceSymbol
methods.description: Determines the icon name based on device family, title, platform.

methods.name: shouldShowUpdateRow
methods.description: Checks whether to show update-related info for an instance.

methods.name: safeSystemSymbol
methods.description: Returns a system symbol name if available, otherwise fallback.

methods.name: isSystemSymbolAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a system icon is available in the current environment.

methods.name: platformIcon
methods.description: Maps platform strings to system icon names.

methods.name: prettyPlatform
methods.description: Converts raw platform strings into user-friendly labels.

methods.name: presenceUpdateSourceShortText
methods.description: Simplifies update source reason strings into short labels.

methods.name: updateSummaryText
methods.description: Generates a summary string about last update time and source for an instance.

methods.name: presenceUpdateSourceHelp
methods.description: Provides help text explaining why presence data was last updated.
